title: [PM seat] repo:cloud · seat 2 — 🟢 hotlong
body:
**This post is the registration of `repo:cloud` seat 2** (`Seat: repo:cloud#2`). Seat 1's post is objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026; it carries the lane's platform facts, the standing bans and the permanent notes, and this post does not copy them. Seat-post protocol: index = `label:pm:seat`; only the sitting PM edits this body; takeover or handover = body edit + audit comment; re-fetch before editing, first stamp wins, read back after writing. 

## 当前 PM

**🟢 `hotlong`** · session `session_0177YcgREB9L8nLcXacfbLvL` · seated 2026-10-23T15:59Z, on the maintainer's word in that session's chat: 「你能不能坐 第二个 cloud seat」. The predecessor's brief (6282211563) was the post's newest event, so the seat was taken at once.
- **Lane rules, restated by the maintainer to this session:**
  - one `os-dev` in flight at a time for this seat (「1 个（推荐）」);
  - p1/p2 only (「只做 p1/p2（推荐）」).
  - any cloud PR with no progress for 6 hours is this seat's to follow up (「6小时没进展的pr你都可以跟进」): read it, drive it to green and to landing through the protocol, and post a pointer on the PR naming the take-up. The original owner's claim stays on its card.
- **Seat 1 is live:** `repo:cloud#1`, session `session_01FSg7JRUiTPo8GrgT38tAWP`; in flight #3156 (PR #3174). Same-seat claims are exclusive; the other seat's claims do not trigger a stand-down. This seat does not take a card that carries a seat-1 `Claim:`.
- **Wake:** session-bound routine `trig_019xArZJQEWXSDoWP7eFdhRK` (every 3 h, `24 */3`).

## 继承台账

- `pm:dispatched` 1: #3087 (`hotlong`). This session's: PR #3176 is green, unreviewed, and authored by this session, so it lands only after an independent review and the maintainer's or seat 1's merge. Then #2913 closes, quoting ruling `6308335510`.
- `pm:blocked` 10: #3172 (p1, `hotlong`, the ops seat's), #3169, #1979 (p1); #3160, #3159, #3155, #3103, #2913 (p2); #3138 (p3, `baozhoutao`); #3149.
  - **#1979 (C10) joins this seat.** It was held as `pm:epic` by this session's epic-remainder role (record 6365742581, re-point 6368429019); an epic PM does not double as a lane seat, so the role ends and the card is this lane's. It waits on #3150.
- `pm:awaiting-maintainer` 10: #3072, #3053, #2914 (p1); #2274 (p2); #2988, #2767, #2549, #2377, #1765 (p3); #786.
- `pm:on-hold` 4: #2546, #2367, #2310, #1288.
- objectstack-ai/objectui: #12724 (`pm:blocked`), held by this seat on the maintainer's 「objectui #12724 和 cloud 相关。你也接手」; #12725 (`pm:awaiting-maintainer`) as the predecessor left it. ⛔ This post lists no inherited rulings.

It waits on the maintainer's `NEON_API_KEY` / `NEON_PROJECT_ID` and the staging generation-1 ceremony. Nothing else in this seat touches the pins.
